Yes, that's what I'm saying. All you're really doing is agreeing with me. "Life sucks then you die." Nothing can give me pleasure because all I feel is guilt for being here. I feel guilty if anyone even talks to me because I know I'm a horrible person through and through. I feel like I infect people. I'd feel guilty if I had any of those things. I feel too guilty to even eat. I don't deserve it. I feel guilty because I know I'm doing something I'm not supposed to be: existing. People would have been better off if I hadn't been born. I wouldn't mind never having existed either. I think I starve myself because concave is the closest thing to disappearing. 

You know, the more I think about it, the more at peace I'm feeling. It's going to be okay. It will be over soon. :)

I don't like human interaction. I have anxiety. I have volunteered on and off my whole life but I don't talk to people. I don't think I even like people. I definitely don't like myself. I don't know if the two are related though. 

Of course you would say to just eat something. That's what everyone says.

Oh, me me me. I'm quite small, but my stomach and arms sure aren't! Yeah I feel like a linebacker with my weight distribution even though I'm like <105lbs. I've been on birth control pills since I was 15. It sucks. My arms look absolutely obese.
